item: asserts that passed on an empty result: eight vacuous sites in six files fixed, eight bare raises narrowed, each proven by a mutant
summary: Counted what 986 assert all/not any/not [..]/== [] sites saw over the whole suite (plugin outside the repo): 70 saw nothing. Sixty-two had a positive control; eight were vacuous and each had a source mutant that stayed green: the entity kind filter, the stats-sources country filter (fixture sources were news), the unsegmented-language non-flagging (a cohort with no spread), the core-dump record shape, the saved search that could not fire (window before the data), and three scanner samples. Eight bare pytest.raises(Exception) around wrong passphrases, an outage and an engine failure now name a class and a match. The country fixture's new rows broke two later tests until they were tagged and disabled (found by the Opus read). Test-only.
